### Janus Living Declares Monthly Common Stock Cash Dividends for the Fourth Quarter of 2026


September 14, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/993969851/files/doc_news/Janus-Living-Declares-Monthly-Common-Stock-Cash-Dividends-for-the-Fourth-Quarter-of-2026-2026.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Janus Living, Inc. (NYSE: JAN) (“Janus Living”), a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust (REIT), announced that on September 11, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a monthly common stock cash dividend of $0.0475 per share for the fourth quarter of 2026, payable on the payment dates set forth in the table below to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the corresponding record date in the table below. The monthly dividend reflects an annualized dividend amount of $0.57 per share of common stock.


**Record Date**


**Payment Date**


**Amount**


October 16, 2026


October 28, 2026


$0.0475 per common share


November 12, 2026


November 23, 2026


$0.0475 per common share


December 18, 2026


December 29, 2026


$0.0475 per common share


**ABOUT JANUS LIVING**


Janus Living, Inc. is a pure-play senior housing real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns high-quality communities across the United States that support residents with thoughtfully designed, highly amenitized environments. For more information regarding Janus Living, visit[www.janusreit.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.janusreit.com&esheet=54602555&newsitemid=20260914791029&lan=en-US&anchor=www.janusreit.com&index=1&md5=5bf7912d1525ecfc4d2b5dc6b4fff3bc) .
